news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or enforcement item found in the sources reachable during this check (company site, Indian Kanoon). Search engine (DuckDuckGo/Searx) was unavailable during the whole session, so this is a limited-coverage result, not a clean bill of health. Company is part of SAR Group (Livpure, Livfast, Lectrix, HEKA), founded 1988 by Rakesh Malhotra and Navneet Kapoor — https://www.livguard.com/about-us/.
note: Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List listing found; however the sanctions lists themselves could not be queried directly (search backend down, sanctionslist search pages not reachable), so sanctions_hit is null = not verified, not 'confirmed clean'. Court cases: 281 Indian Kanoon hits for the name; the visible ones are almost all the company as PETITIONER in commercial arbitration/enforcement against dealers-distributors (Sri Velavan Battery Service, Shiv Shakti Agencies, New Aggarwal Agencies, Raghav Motors) plus a trademark suit against an individual (Kritika Soni) and a trademark dispute where it is respondent (V-Guard Industries, 06.01.2023). No insolvency/NCLT or criminal matter surfaced. Per project rules these are not rejection grounds and are noted neutrally. Credit rating: no public rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) found — null, not public in reachable sources. RF/CIS supply: no evidence found; Indian Kanoon query 'Livguard Russia' returned 0 results, and the company's own site lists only generic 'international operations' with an export mailbox (export@sar-group.com) — that is a claim, not a confirmed shipment. No customs/B-L record of supplies to Russia or CIS was found in reachable sources. Coverage caveat: web_search tool failed throughout (connection refused), so only direct fetches of livguard.com and indiankanoon.org were possible; OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS list checks and credit-rating agency pages remain unverified and should be re-run when search is restored.
